L105: Show! Music Core Chart winners (2023)
L106: ---
L107: The Show! Music Core Chart is a 【37†record chart】 on the South Korean 【38†MBC】 television music program 【39†Show! Music Core】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【40†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L108: In 2023, 29 singles achieved number one on the chart, and 23 acts were awarded first-place trophies. "【41†I Am】" by 【42†Ive】 had the highest score of the year, with 9,668 points on the April 22 broadcast. 【43†(G)I-dle】's "【44†Queencard】" becomes the only song to receive a 【45†Quintuple Crown】.
L109: 
L110: 【42†Ive】's (pictured) win for "【41†I Am】" had the highest score of 2023, with 9,668 points at the April 22 broadcast
L111: ## Chart history

L115: 【47†BSS】 (top), 【48†STAYC】 (middle), and 【49†Stray Kids】 (bottom) received their first Show! Music Core trophies for "【50†Fighting】," "【51†Teddy Bear】," and "【52†Lalalala】," respectively.
L116: 【53†Shinee】's 【54†Onew】 (Top left), 【55†Exo】's 【56†Kai】 (Top right), 【57†Blackpink】's 【58†Jisoo】 (Bottom left) and 【59†BTS】's 【60†Jungkook】 (Bottom right) received their first Show! Music Core trophies as soloists with "O (Circle)", "【61†Rover】", "【62†Flower】" and "【63†Seven】", respectively.
